exposure: elevated HbA1c in the first trimester (HbA1c-FT)
elevated HbA1c in the first trimester
cohort: 1618 pregnant Asian Indian women without gestational diabetes who delivered at a single urban tertiary care center and had HbA1c-FT estimation between January 2011 and September 2017
finding: In Asian Indian women without gestational diabetes, elevated HbA1c in the first trimester was associated with preterm birth and primary caesarean delivery, but not with other adverse events.
mod_finding: This study found that elevated HbA1c in the first trimester was associated with an increased risk of primary caesarean delivery among Asian Indian women.
